title: Working of Institutions
subtitle: Understanding the Democratic Setup of India
subject: Social Science (Civics)
author: Antigravity
learning_outcomes: Understand the need for political institutions.
Describe the role of the Parliament.
Explain the functions of the Political and Permanent Executive.
Understand the powers and independence of the Judiciary.

ai_context.learning_goal: Master the structure and function of India's core democratic institutions (Legislature, Executive, Judiciary).
common_misconceptions: The Prime Minister can make any law without the Parliament.
Civil servants are part of the political executive.
ai_context.tutor_hint: If the student struggles with the difference between political and permanent executive, ask them who gets elected every 5 years and who passes a competitive exam to stay until retirement.
